etymology_chain.definition: to accrue, to bring together, to compile

definitions.text_mt: Ġemma': ħa flus u warrabhom għall-użu fil-ġejjieni
Ġemma': warrab flus regolarment għal skop partikolari
Ġemma': ġabar flimkien affarijiet mifruxin

definitions.text_en: to make a collection of (e.g. stamps)
definitions.text_mt: Ġemma': ġabar oġġetti ta' tip partikolari bħala kollezzjoni

usage_examples.maltese: Qed niġma' flus biex nixtri dar.
usage_examples.english: I am saving money to buy a house.

usage_examples.maltese: Huwa ġema' biżżejjed għall-vjaġġ.
usage_examples.english: He saved enough for the trip.

usage_examples.maltese: Kull xahar niġma' mitt ewro mill-paga tiegħi.
usage_examples.english: Every month I put aside a hundred euros from my salary.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-bdiewa ġemgħu l-qamħ mill-għelieqi.
usage_examples.english: The farmers gathered the wheat from the fields.

usage_examples.maltese: Ġbart ġemgħa kbira ta' bolli tal-posta minn madwar id-dinja.
usage_examples.english: I collected a large collection of postage stamps from around the world.

usage_examples.maltese: Ommi ġemgħat dolls qodma ta' kull tip.
usage_examples.english: My mother collected old dolls of every kind.

definitions.text_en: to emit soot, to be sooty
definitions.text_mt: Ġemmed: sustanza sewda u trabija li titla' min-nar u titħanex mal-uċuħ

definitions.text_en: to cover (something) in soot (by extension) to blacken, to give a dark discoloration to
definitions.text_mt: Ġemmed: tiskurija ta' wiċċ minħabba duħħan jew ħruq

definitions.text_en: to congeal (something), to make thick, viscous
definitions.text_mt: Ġemmed: sustanza li ssir ħoxna u iebsa bil-ksieh
Ġemmed: qerq jew ingann fi tranżazzjoni

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ħajt kien miksi b'saff oħxon ta' ġemmed.
usage_examples.english: The wall was covered with a thick layer of soot.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġemmed fuq il-borma ma tantx kien jitneħħa faċilment.
usage_examples.english: The soot on the pot was not easy to remove.

usage_examples.maltese: Iż-żejt sar ġemmed wara li tħalla fil-kesħa.
usage_examples.english: The oil turned into a congealed substance after being left in the cold.

usage_examples.maltese: Kien hemm ġemmed fil-kuntratt li ħadd ma nduna bih.
usage_examples.english: There was a trick in the contract that no one noticed.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenb: in-naħa ta' barra ta' xi ħaġa, il-parti laterali
Ġenb: il-parti tal-ġisem bejn il-kustilji u l-ġenbejn

usage_examples.maltese: Poġġejt il-borża ma' ġenb is-siġġu.
usage_examples.english: I placed the bag at the side of the chair.

usage_examples.maltese: Fetaħ bieb fil-ġenb tal-bini.
usage_examples.english: He opened a door in the side of the building.

usage_examples.maltese: Ħassejt uġiegħ qawwi f'ġenbi wara l-waqgħa.
usage_examples.english: I felt a sharp pain in my side after the fall.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenbel: laqat b'daqqa qawwija

usage_examples.maltese: Ġenbilu b'qatta' ħabel fuq dahru.
usage_examples.english: He struck him with a piece of rope on his back.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ħaddiem ġenbel l-imħaba b'martell.
usage_examples.english: The worker struck the chisel with a hammer.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenerali: li jirrigwarda l-biċċa l-kbira; mhux speċifiku

usage_examples.maltese: L-idea ġenerali tal-proġett kienet ċara għal kulħadd.
usage_examples.english: The general idea of the project was clear to everyone.

usage_examples.maltese: B'mod ġenerali, il-kundizzjonijiet tjiebu matul is-sena.
usage_examples.english: In general, conditions improved over the year.

definitions.text_mt: Ġeneralità: kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li hija ġenerali u mhux speċifika

usage_examples.maltese: Id-diskors kien mimli ġeneralitajiet u ma qal xejn konkret.
usage_examples.english: The speech was full of generalities and said nothing concrete.

definitions.text_mt: Ġeneralizzar: il-proċess li bih wieħed japplika regola wiesgħa bbażata fuq ġabra ta' każijiet partikolari

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġeneralizzar huwa pass importanti fix-xjenza.
usage_examples.english: Generalisation is an important step in science.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġeneralizzar mgħaġġel spiss iwassal għal konklużjonijiet żbaljati.
usage_examples.english: Hasty generalisation often leads to wrong conclusions.

definitions.text_mt: Ġeneralizzazzjoni: dikjarazzjoni jew konklużjoni wiesgħa bbażata fuq tħaddim ta' prinċipju lil diversi każijiet

usage_examples.maltese: Din il-ġeneralizzazzjoni mhix applikabbli għal kull sitwazzjoni.
usage_examples.english: This generalisation is not applicable to every situation.

usage_examples.maltese: Huwa għamel ġeneralizzazzjoni dwar it-tfal kollha abbażi ta' ftit eżempji biss.
usage_examples.english: He made a generalisation about all children based on only a few examples.

definitions.text_mt: Ġeneraliżmu: approċċ li bih wieħed jipprova jkollu għarfien wiesa' f'ħafna oqsma minflok speċjalizza f'qasam wieħed

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġeneraliżmu kien apprezzat aktar fi żminijiet antiki.
usage_examples.english: Generalisme was more appreciated in ancient times.

usage_examples.maltese: Fid-dinja moderna, il-ġeneraliżmu spiss iċedi għall-ispeċjalizzazzjoni.
usage_examples.english: In the modern world, generalism often gives way to specialisation.

definitions.text_mt: Ġeneralment: b'mod ġenerali; fil-biċċa l-kbira tal-każijiet

usage_examples.maltese: Ġeneralment, il-ħwienet jagħlqu fil-ħdax ta' billejl.
usage_examples.english: Generally, the shops close at eleven at night.

usage_examples.maltese: Is-sajf f'Malta ġeneralment ikun sħun u niexef.
usage_examples.english: Summer in Malta is generally hot and dry.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenerativ: li għandu l-abbiltà li jiġġenera, jipproduċi jew joħloq xi ħaġa

usage_examples.maltese: Il-lingwistika ġenerattiva tistudja kif il-bniedem jipproduċi u jifhem il-lingwa.
usage_examples.english: Generative linguistics studies how humans produce and understand language.

usage_examples.maltese: L-intelliġenza artifiċjali ġenerattiva toħloq kontenut ġdid bbażat fuq data eżistenti.
usage_examples.english: Generative artificial intelligence creates new content based on existing data.

definitions.text_mt: Ġeneratur: magna jew apparat li jipproduċi l-elettriku jew enerġija oħra

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġeneratur beda jaħdem waqt il-waqfien tad-dawl.
usage_examples.english: The generator started working during the power cut.

usage_examples.maltese: Ġeneratur ġdid ġie installat fl-istazzjon tal-enerġija.
usage_examples.english: A new generator was installed at the power station.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenerazzjoni: il-grupp kollu ta' nies imwielda u li jgħixu fi żmien wieħed

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġenerazzjoni l-ġdida għandha teknoloġija li n-naħna ma kellniex.
usage_examples.english: The new generation has technology that we did not have.

usage_examples.maltese: Din it-tradizzjoni għaddiet minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.
usage_examples.english: This tradition passed from one generation to another.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenetiku: relatat mal-ġeni u l-wirt bijoloġiku

usage_examples.maltese: Il-marda għandha bażi ġenetika qawwija.
usage_examples.english: The disease has a strong genetic basis.

usage_examples.maltese: L-istudji ġenetiċi għenu biex nifhmu aħjar l-istorja tal-bniedem.
usage_examples.english: Genetic studies helped us better understand human history.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenitali: relatat mal-organi riproduttivi esterni

usage_examples.maltese: L-iġjene ġenitali hija importanti għas-saħħa ġenerali.
usage_examples.english: Genital hygiene is important for overall health.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenitali: l-organi riproduttivi esterni tal-bniedem u l-annimali

usage_examples.maltese: It-tabib spjega l-anatomija tal-ġenitali umani.
usage_examples.english: The doctor explained the anatomy of the human genitalia.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenitur: missier jew omm wieħed

usage_examples.maltese: Iż-żewġ ġenituri attendew għal-laqgħa tal-iskola.
usage_examples.english: Both parents attended the school meeting.

usage_examples.maltese: Kull ġenitur irid jieħu ħsieb it-tfal tiegħu.
usage_examples.english: Every parent must take care of his or her children.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġenituri tiegħi għallmuni l-valuri importanti tal-ħajja.
usage_examples.english: My parents taught me the important values of life.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenjali: li juri kreattività kbira u intelliġenza oerhört brillanti
Ġenjali: li jagħmel pjaċir u jqanqal simpatija fl-oħrajn

usage_examples.maltese: Idea ġenjali waslitlu f'mument ta' ispirazzjoni.
usage_examples.english: A brilliant idea came to him in a moment of inspiration.

usage_examples.maltese: Huwa persuna ġenjali li kulħadd iħobb.
usage_examples.english: He is a pleasant person whom everyone likes.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenjalità: il-kwalità li wieħed ikun simpatiku, pjaċevoli u akkoljenti

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġenjalità tiegħu għamlet il-laqgħa pjaċevoli għal kulħadd.
usage_examples.english: His likeability made the meeting pleasant for everyone.

usage_examples.maltese: Dejjem nilqa' n-nies b'ġenjalità u tbissima.
usage_examples.english: I always welcome people with warmth and a smile.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenjalment: b'mod intelliġenti, oriġinali u kreattiv

usage_examples.maltese: Hi solviet il-problema ġenjalment fi ftit minuti biss.
usage_examples.english: She solved the problem ingeniously in just a few minutes.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenn: stat fejn wieħed jitlef ir-raġuni u l-kapaċità li jaħseb b'mod ċar
Ġenn: nuqqas totali ta' ordni, loġika jew ċarezza

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġenn tiegħu kien dovut għall-istress u n-nuqqas ta' rqad.
usage_examples.english: His madness was due to stress and lack of sleep.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-film juri l-vjaġġ ta' raġel fil-ġenn.
usage_examples.english: The film shows a man's journey into madness.

usage_examples.maltese: Kien hemm ġenn fit-toroq wara l-attakk.
usage_examples.english: There was chaos in the streets after the attack.

definitions.text_en: paradise (idealistic abode in this world, e.g. that of Adam and Eve)
definitions.text_mt: Ġenna: il-ġnien ta' l-għaxqa fejn għexu Adam u Eva skont it-tradizzjoni
Ġenna: post ta' hena etern fejn imorru l-erwieħ tal-ġusti wara l-mewt

definitions.text_en: paradise (otherworldly abode of the righteous or justified)
definitions.text_mt: Ġenna: post jew esperjenza ta' hena u ferħ perfett

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġrajja ta' Adam u Eva fil-ġenna hija magħrufa mad-dinja kollha.
usage_examples.english: The story of Adam and Eve in paradise is known throughout the world.

usage_examples.maltese: Skont it-twemmin Nisrani, min imut fil-grazzja ta' Alla jmur il-ġenna.
usage_examples.english: According to Christian belief, whoever dies in God's grace goes to heaven.

usage_examples.maltese: Kienet ġenna li tqatta' l-vaganzi ma' ħbiebek.
usage_examples.english: It was paradise to spend the holidays with your friends.

definitions.text_mt: Ġennata: azzjoni iblah jew bla sens li turi nuqqas ta' ġudizzju
Ġennata: wieħed mill-ġennati, imġieba li ma tagħmilx sens

usage_examples.maltese: Kienet ġennata li ħalliet il-bieb miftuħ għall-barranin.
usage_examples.english: It was a foolish act that she left the door open for strangers.

usage_examples.maltese: Li tixrob l-ilma baħar hija ġennata perikoluża.
usage_examples.english: Drinking seawater is a dangerous foolish act.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenneb: warrab xi ħaġa jew ħalla minn naħa għall-użu aktar tard
Ġenneb: ħelef flus billi nefaq inqas milli kien imdorri

usage_examples.maltese: Ġennejt xi ftit mill-ikel għal għada.
usage_examples.english: I put aside some of the food for tomorrow.

usage_examples.maltese: Huwa ġenneb il-ġurnal biex jaqrah wara.
usage_examples.english: He put the newspaper aside to read later.

usage_examples.maltese: Qed niġenneb kull xahar biex insiefer fis-sajf.
usage_examples.english: I am saving money every month to travel in summer.

definitions.text_mt: Ġennen: ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlef ir-raġuni jew il-kontroll tiegħu
Ġennen: ħawwad lil xi ħadd, għamlu jitlef il-ħila li jaħseb b'mod razzjonali

usage_examples.maltese: L-istress qed jiġennen lin-nies f'dan il-ħin tal-eżamijiet.
usage_examples.english: The stress is driving people crazy at this exam time.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ħsejjes qawwija ġennnu lill-ġar il-qadim.
usage_examples.english: The loud noises drove the old neighbour crazy.

usage_examples.maltese: L-aħbar kienet biżżejjed biex tiġġennu u ma jibqax jaf x'jagħmel.
usage_examples.english: The news was enough to confuse him and leave him not knowing what to do.
